messages:
paul_sales: Hi @tanya_csm — handing off CureWave pilot (CW-PILOT-7). 30-day trial starts Mon. Main asks: SAML SSO, private VPC peering, and an embeddings-based search for clinical notes. Customer lead: emily@curewave.com. Success metric for renewal: FRT (first response time) < 100ms for 90% of queries and embedding cost < $0.00045/token.
tanya_csm: Thanks Paul. Quick Q: who will own VPC peering and who owns data mapping for notes ingestion?
paul_sales: Kai (infra) will provision peering + reserved pool. CS (me + tanya) will handle mapping and test datasets. Customer requested a 45-minute handover Wed 9am PT.
kai_infra: Got it. Constraints: CureWave requires egress from static IPs and must run in us-west-2. I'll open INF-9021 for reserved pool + NAT IPs. Note: expect cold-start tail latency on day 0; recommend prewarm.
rachel_support: Support handover: rotation set to @rachel_support weekdays 8-6 PT. I'll create SUP-6001 and a private channel #curewave-support. Need runbook link and escalation path.
paul_sales: Runbook & docs uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/curewave (internal). Security addendum in Drive.
tanya_csm: Action list I'm tracking: 1) schedule Wed 9am handover (owner: paul_sales) 2) CS onboarding draft (owner: tanya_csm) 3) infra ticket INF-9021 (owner: kai_infra) 4) SAML metadata exchange (owner: emily@curewave / tanya_csm). Add SLA/renewal notes?
kai_infra: INF-9021 ETA: provisioned by Fri if peering request approved. We'll use quant profile q5_6 to meet cost target; slight accuracy difference possible — capture evaluation prompts.
tanya_csm: I'll run an eval harness on q5_6 pre-launch. Need 12 customer-critical prompts from CureWave— @paul_sales can you request that?
paul_sales: Emily said she'll share prompts by Tue EOD.
rachel_support: Support setup: SUP-6001 created, private Slack #curewave-support created. Monitoring thresholds: avg latency > 120ms or error rate > 2% trigger paging.
ops-bot: ops-bot: INF-9021 created and assigned to kai_infra.
tanya_csm: Risk notes: renewal risk = medium. Key technical risks: VPC peering delays, KV cache warm-up, quantized-model regressions. Ops risk: activation slipping past 14 days.
paul_sales: Sales notes: emphasize embedding unit economics to the customer; they'll escalate if cost per search > $0.10. Capture cost per search metric weekly.
tanya_csm: Weekly check-in scheduled Thu 10am PT; invite sent to emily + internal owners. I'll create a feedback doc and regression tracker: https://redwood.internal/ops/curewave-feedback.
kai_infra: Prewarm command for CS to use before traffic starts: ``curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/prewarm -d '{"model":"embed-pro-1","qps":45}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'``. That will populate KV and reduce tail latency. Use during maintenance window.
rachel_support: I'll add warmup steps and healthcheck script to the runbook and attach to SUP-6001. Also adding PagerDuty rotation and playbook.
paul_sales: Final check: can owners please confirm and list immediate next steps here?
tanya_csm: Owners: CS onboarding = tanya_csm; infra provisioning = kai_infra; support lead = rachel_support; sales follow-ups = paul_sales. Next steps: 1) paul request prompts by Tue EOD, 2) kai update INF-9021 with IPs by Thu, 3) tanya publish onboarding plan by Thu EOD, 4) rachel post runbook updates and healthchecks to #curewave-support.
rachel_support: Confirmed. I'll run an initial monitor at 8:30am PT on pilot start day and enable alerts.
paul_sales: Thanks all 44d I'll run the Wed handover and invite CureWave infra.
tanya_csm: Thanks team 64c I'll prepare eval harness and feedback doc.
